name: Pate Chinois
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on standard shepherd's pie/casserole recipes using 450g beef and 4 cups potatoes for a family-sized 8-inch square dish

Total time is sum of active prep/cooking steps (potato boiling ~20 min, mashing ~5 min, onion/meat browning ~10 min, assembly ~5 min) plus bake 30 min + broil ~5 min + cool 10 min, rounded conservatively
Gluten-free assumes no hidden gluten in creamed corn or spices (common in commercial products but not explicitly listed)
Soy ambiguous due to possible additives in commercial creamed corn or minced beef
Eggs confidently absent as no egg listed or implied
Dairy present via butter and milk
Parsley assumed fresh but does not affect classifications
instructions:
In a large pot of salted water, cook the potatoes until they are very tender. Drain.
With a masher, coarsely crush the potatoes with at least 30 ml (2 tablespoons) of butter. With an electric mixer, purée with the milk. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
In a large skillet, brown the onion in the remaining butter. Add the meat and cook until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat.
Lightly press the meat at the bottom of a 20-cm (8-inch) square baking dish. Cover with the corn and the mashed potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
Bake for about 30 minutes. Finish cooking under the broiler. Let cool for 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 4 cups mashed potato volume equates to ~640g peeled/boiled potatoes based on typical recipe yield and density

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: 60 ml butter (standard 2 tbsp = 28 g, so full amount ~55 g)

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: ½ cup milk is approximately 120 ml / 123 g using 2% milk as standard

ingredients.name: Minced Beef
ingredients.assumptions: Raw minced/ground beef (80/20 typical for recipes); 450 g as given

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion finely chopped is ~110 g raw

ingredients.name: Creamed Corn
ingredients.assumptions: 500 ml creamed corn (density ~0.96 g/ml) = 480 g; typical canned values used

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.assumptions: Paprika 'to taste' estimated at 1 g (small sprinkle for whole dish)

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Parsley 'to taste' estimated at 2 g fresh (small garnish amount)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Salt 'dash' estimated at 1 g (typical small seasoning amount); contributes negligible macros

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pepper 'dash' estimated at 1 g (typical small seasoning amount); contributes negligible macros
